messages:
sam: Hawks just hit a 7-0 run, refreshing the feed like it's my job :eyes:. Quick poll — if my fantasy squad somehow sneaks the office pool, who claims the championship donut box? 🍩
leah: On call but peeking. if it's maple i'm in. otherwise i'll accept crumbs. :sweat_smile:
devan: Maple? fight me. chocolate sprinkles all the way. also my waiver app froze when i tried to bench K — anyone else seeing that? :rage:
ryan: I put in my unofficial veto: sprinkles. If Sam wins, Sam brings. If Sam loses, Dev buys the box. fair? :money_with_wings:
scorebot: Game update: Hawks 89 — Nets 87 (Q4 10:23).
sam: thanks scorebot. @devan try `brew restart-waivers` — ops mentioned a sticky job queue earlier.
leah: side bet: last-minute 3-pointer — winner chooses team coffee shop next week. whos in? ☕️
devan: in. putting 2 maple donuts as collateral. code for accountability: ```deposit: 2 maple donuts -> escrow @ryan```
ryan: agreed. also adding a tiny rule: if donut box is chocolate sprinkles, i'll split half with the oncall person. sharing is caring. :handshake:
sam: poll time — react with :maple:, :choc:, or :glazed: for your pick. current picks: maple (leah, ryan), chocolate (devan).
scorebot: Update: Nets timeout. Hawks ball. Q4 06:07.
leah: also shoutout to @sam for last week's fantasy trade. that pickup sealed it. :trophy:
devan: true. kudos. also im vetoing any donut with weird filling (custard, jam) — i'm allergic to regret. :grimacing:
ryan: reminder: whoever loses the donut bet has to bring napkins and coffee refill on Monday. low stakes, high morale.
sam: great. placing bets and refreshing the stream. may the best donut-lover win. :crossed_fingers:
